name: cavemio-breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: Where you are and the way back: a long trail folds its middle into "…", which opens the hidden crumbs in place one after another.

cavemio.usage:
import { Breadcrumb } from "@/components/breadcrumb";

<Breadcrumb items={[{ label: "Projects", href: "/projects" }, { label: "Northwind", href: "/projects/northwind" }, { label: "Assets" }]} />
cavemio.accessibility:
- A nav landmark labelled "Breadcrumb" with an ordered list.
- Reduced motion: the crumbs appear at once.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

useCases.title: Docs
useCases.description: Section and page above the title.

features.title: Folding middle
features.description: First and last two stay; the rest fold into "…".

features.title: Opens in place
features.description: Widths ease open with a 40ms stagger.

features.title: Links or buttons
features.description: href for routing, onClick for app state.

states.title: folded
states.description: "…" stands in for the middle crumbs.

states.title: opened
states.description: Each hidden crumb's width eases open (380ms, 40ms apart) and fades in.
